messages.en: Aina, there's a snake behind your house. I saw it earlier.
Thanks, Amir. I've already called the fire brigade. Just wait outside, okay?

senses.en_definition: Abbreviation for Universiti Malaya (the University of Malaya), normally written UM.

messages.en: I'm at UM now. Where are you?
I'm in front of the library. Which gate did you come in through?
The main gate. I'm walking over now. Hang on a sec, okay?
How old is your child now?
Already six! Starting primary school next year.
There are two computers left in the storeroom. Want to take one?
Just one, thanks. Keep the other one for now.
